items.source: Redis command methods are exempted from the default non-nullable return value assumption as nullness depends not only on the command but also on the connection state. Methods invoked during a transaction or while pipelining are required to return null at the time invoking a command as the response is not available until the transaction is executed or the pipeline is closed. To avoid excessive null checks in calling code and to not express a faulty assumption of non-nullness, all command interfaces are annotated with @NullUnmarked.
items.translation: Redis 命令方法免除了默认的非空返回值假设，因为是否为 null 不仅取决于命令本身，还取决于连接状态。在事务期间或管道模式下调用的方法必须在调用命令时返回 null，因为响应只有在事务执行完成或管道关闭后才可用。为了避免调用代码中出现过多的 null 检查，并避免表达错误的非空假设，所有命令接口均标注了 @NullUnmarked。

items.source:
Executes the given action within a Redis connection. Application exceptions thrown by the action object get
propagated to the caller (can only be unchecked) whenever possible. Redis exceptions are transformed into
appropriate DAO ones. Allows for returning a result object, that is a domain object or a collection of domain
objects. Performs automatic serialization/deserialization for the given objects to and from binary data suitable
for the Redis storage. Note: Callback code is not supposed to handle transactions itself! Use an appropriate
transaction manager. Generally, callback code must not touch any Connection lifecycle methods, like close, to let
the template do its work.
items.translation: 在 Redis 连接中执行给定的操作。操作对象抛出的应用程序异常尽可能传播给调用者（仅限 unchecked 异常）。Redis 异常被转换为适当的 DAO 异常。允许返回结果对象，即域对象或域对象的集合。对给定对象执行自动的序列化/反序列化，将其转换为适合 Redis 存储的二进制数据。注意：回调代码不应自行处理事务！请使用适当的事务管理器。通常，回调代码不应调用任何连接生命周期方法（如 close），以便模板能够正常工作。
